scope: Static review of after-dispatch orchestration; acceptance rules remain delegated to frozen C193/C194 readers and unchanged receiving tools
checks_passed: Frozen public manifest and inherited preparation verified
Author and coordinator frozen tool files verified
Pinned Blender executable checked before native work
Retained source hash and exact canonical case checked
OntoKin accepted-store namespace and pointer checked
Unchanged saved-scene reopen uses complete481sample equality
Clean rebuild compared on canonical/native/raw/final bytes
Submitted-run inventory compared before and after validation
Failed automated gate cannot return success

findings.issue: Manifest count alone does not enforce route/case matrix; two same-route G deliveries with distinct IDs could satisfy route_equality
findings.fix: Require exact unique pairs: first{(G,ok),(G,python)}; reuse{(G,ok),(G,python),(H,ok),(H,python)} before any native work

findings.issue: First-accepted regeneration check is optional through preserve_from; reuse G rows can omit it yet pass
findings.fix: Require preserve_from for both G rows in the four-row reuse invocation, bound to identified first accepted artifacts

findings.issue: Original editable source is outside submitted run inventory; script hashes it before validation but not after, and preserve_from checks only canonical/native/raw/final files
findings.fix: Record and compare submitted source hash after validation; independently retain first accepted source identity across reuse, either here or in a separate mandatory receipt

decision: Enforce M1 and M2 before using this orchestrator for protocol acceptance; O1 needs explicit source-preservation evidence
